concerns.text: FR-001 requires deterministic site selection based on >80% cloud-free coverage. Task T011a implements the selection logic, but Task T015 (explicitly for flagging/excluding sites with <80% coverage) is marked [ ] (unimplemented). Without T015, the exclusion logic mandated by FR-001 and the Edge Case section is missing.

FR-003 requires mapping ground-truth phenology to sites. The Edge Case section mandates handling missing labels by masking rows. Task T016 (implementing this masking logic) is marked [ ] (unimplemented), leaving the spec's edge case handling unimplemented.

Plan 'Critical Methodological Updates' mandates Spatial Block Cross-Validation and Temporal Holdout. Task T023 references a 'golden_ratio' claim (`{{claim:c_2ff485b7}}`) for validation strategy, which contradicts the plan. No task explicitly implements Spatial Block CV logic (T040 only logs clusters, doesn't implement the split).
FR-004 requires fallback to LightGBM if XGBoost fails. Task T022 mentions the fallback but is marked [ ] (unimplemented). No code artifact exists to satisfy this requirement.
FR-005 requires evaluation metrics (RMSE, MAE, R²). Task T024 is marked [ ] (unimplemented). No task exists to calculate these metrics on held-out sets.
FR-006 requires sensitivity analysis sweeping alpha. Task T028 is marked [ ] (unimplemented). No task exists to perform the sweep or report variation.
FR-007 requires ranking predictors with permutation importance > 0.01. Task T029 is marked [ ] (unimplemented). No task exists to calculate or rank these.
Plan 'Constraints' requires data streaming to prevent OOM. Task T038 is marked [ ] (unimplemented). Without this, the 7GB RAM constraint may be violated during ingestion.

Task T002, T003, T004, T006, T008 are marked [ ] (unimplemented) with no code artifacts. These are foundational tasks required for the project to run. Their absence blocks all subsequent user stories.

Task T023 references a non-existent claim `{{claim:c_2ff485b7}}` (golden_ratio) for validation strategy. This claim does not exist in the spec or plan, which explicitly require Spatial Block CV and Temporal Holdout. This is a stale/hallucinated tag.
